storyline.real: Verstappen wins from pole and Pérez is second. Leclerc's engine fails while he runs third, and Alonso, on a later second stop, passes Sainz for the last podium place; Sainz finishes fourth, 9.4 s behind Alonso.
storyline.headline: Sainz holds Alonso off in Bahrain

mastery.label: Finish fourth or better on three stops

hidden.label: Finish fourth or better without a single push lap

eras.briefing: Bahrain, 2023. Verstappen leads from pole and Leclerc runs second. You run Sainz, fourth after ten laps; Alonso is seventh after his team-mate Stroll hit him on the opening lap. Bring the car home no lower than fourth, and beat Alonso to rewrite the day.
